description: This file defines the OrganizationOnboardingRepository class with methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting organization onboarding records in a database, along with related type definitions and imports.

classes.name: OrganizationOnboardingRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods for managing organization onboarding data in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization onboarding record with provided data.

methods.name: findByStripeCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves an onboarding record by Stripe customer ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an onboarding record by its unique ID.

methods.name: findByOrgOwnerEmail
methods.description: Finds an onboarding record by the organization owner's email.

methods.name: markAsComplete
methods.description: Marks an onboarding record as complete, setting error to null and isComplete to true.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing onboarding record with new data.

methods.name: findByOrganizationId
methods.description: Finds an onboarding record by organization ID.

methods.name: findAllBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves all onboarding records matching a specific slug.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an onboarding record by ID.
